ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across central and proximal fluke areas, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottling is mapped to the trailing edge and distal tips of both lobes; the left tip exhibits a high-contrast white cluster, while the right tip shows more diffused grey-to-white transitions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped median notch with a narrow internal pixel angle of approximately 40-45 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged profile along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by numerous low-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer trailing edges follow a generally concave curve from the median notch toward the distal tips, while the overall fluke span follows a wide convex upward arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered, high-contrast white pixel circular patterns located at the distal extremity of the left fluke tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white scarring and potential barnacle attachment marks on the far left fluke tip and scattered white punctate marks on the central-right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and 'tattered' trailing edge morphology, significantly divergent from a smooth geometric curve.
